title: Data Retention Policy
content:
# Data Retention Policy

## Metric Data Retention by Plan

- **Starter**: 7 days of metric data.
- **Pro**: 30 days of metric data.
- **Enterprise**: 365 days of metric data.

## What Data is Retained

- **Metric data**: Time-series data from all monitored resources.
- **Alert history**: Records of all alert triggers, acknowledgments, and resolutions.
- **Audit logs**: User actions, configuration changes, and access logs.
- **Dashboard configurations**: Saved dashboards and widget configurations.
- **Integration logs**: Connection status and sync history.

## Data After Retention Period

- Metric data beyond the retention window is **automatically archived**.
- Archived data is stored for an additional **90 days** in compressed format.
- Archived data is not queryable through the dashboard but can be exported via the API (Enterprise only).
- After the archive period, data is **permanently deleted**.

## Data Export

- Enterprise customers can export data at any time via **Settings > Data > Export**.
- Supported formats: CSV, JSON, Parquet.
- Exports include metric data, alert history, and audit logs.

## Compliance

- CloudDash is SOC 2 Type II compliant.
- GDPR: Users can request data deletion via **Settings > Privacy > Data Deletion Request**.
- All data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+).
- Data residency options are available for Enterprise customers (US, EU, APAC).

## Account Deletion

- When an account is cancelled, all data is retained for **30 days**.
- After 30 days, all data is permanently and irreversibly deleted.
- To request immediate deletion, contact support at privacy@clouddash.io.
